rationale: The tape is internally conflicted: price has recovered off the gap-down open and holds above session VWAP ($8.47) and the 9-EMA in a tight coil under the $8.55 day high, yet the last three 1-minute prints fade sequentially with the heaviest volume on the down-closes, indicating two-way absorption rather than continuation. Meanwhile the daily structure is still down — below the prior close ($8.63) with an unfilled gap — so a long is counter to the larger trend and a short is counter to the intraday trend. With spread plus a ~0.5%-per-5-minute ATR, either direction offers roughly 1:1 reward-to-risk on the evidence available, so paying the costs has no edge; stand aside and re-evaluate on a decisive break of $8.55 or a VWAP reclaim failure.
